acceptance_criteria.criterion: All new test cases pass (dotnet test on VideoIndexer.Tests project).
TagsManagerTests uses in-memory fakes; no DB connection required.
FilterExpressionEvaluatorM7Tests uses synthetic MovieListItem instances; Evaluate called as static method.
NameParserDetectTagsTests constructs real NameParser instance with 5-parameter Parse.
No NotImplementedException or placeholder test bodies.

summary: Created TagsManagerTests.cs — 13 test cases covering weight clamping (below min, above max, in-range), NameWithPath (root, child), effective tag set via parent/grant/transitive chain, parent cycle detection (self-loop, ancestor chain), grant cycle self-loop, Most Used virtual category placement, and zero-usage importance ranking. Uses in-memory fakes (StubTagsRepository, StubConnectionFactory, StubDbConnection : DbConnection, StubDbCommand : DbCommand, StubDbParameterCollection : DbParameterCollection, StubDbDataReader : DbDataReader, StubSettings). No DB connection required.

Created FilterExpressionEvaluatorM7Tests.cs — 11 M7 DSL test cases: StoredTagsWeight comparisons, AmountStoredTags comparisons, HasTags() true/false, StudioContains match/no-match, HasTag(id) true/false via EffectiveTagIds, TagHasSubTags(id) true/false via StoredTagParentIds, combined HasTags() AND HasTag(7) expression.

Created NameParserDetectTagsTests.cs — 3 cases: DetectTags=false returns empty even with known tags, DetectTags=true detects matching tag names, DetectTags=true with empty known-tag list returns empty.
All 714 tests pass across all three test projects (288 App, 177 Infrastructure [6 env-skips], 255 Core). Build clean.

comments.note: The TagsManager fakes require DbConnection/DbCommand/DbDataReader abstract base classes because Dapper 2.1.x casts IDbCommand to DbCommand in its async code path. If a future WP extracts LoadUsageCountsAsync into ITagsRepository, the IDbConnectionFactory dependency on TagsManager could be removed, eliminating this complexity and making unit tests significantly simpler.

StubDbParameterCollection has two CS8765 warnings (nullability mismatch on SetParameter overrides). These are suppressed by TreatWarningsAsErrors=false in the test project but indicate the base class changed its signature between .NET SDK versions. Consider aligning with the exact .NET 10 signature once stable.

TagsManagerTests.Importance_ZeroUsage_AllTagsAreUnused only tests the zero-usage case. A complementary test for the non-trivial importance bucketing (VeryHigh top decile) was deferred to avoid exceeding the 13-case target. It can be added as a follow-up using a configurable StubDbDataReader with non-zero rows.

summary: All 255 VideoIndexer.Tests tests pass (27 new + 228 pre-existing). AC-1: verified by test run. AC-2: StubTagsRepository returns hardcoded in-memory lists; StubDbConnection/StubDbCommand/StubDbDataReader never touch a real database. AC-3: FilterExpressionEvaluatorM7Tests creates synthetic MovieListItem records with `DefaultItem() with { }` and calls FilterExpressionEvaluator.Evaluate(Parse(...), item) as a static method in all 11 cases. AC-4: NameParserDetectTagsTests uses a single static `new NameParser()` field and calls Sut.Parse with 5 args (input, options, knownActorNames, knownStudios, knownTagNames) in all 3 cases. AC-5: NotImplementedException in StubTagsRepository appears only in never-invoked stub paths (mutation methods), not in any test method body; all test methods contain FluentAssertions assertions.

metrics.test_coverage: 255/255 core tests (27 new WP-019 cases + 228 pre-existing)

comments.note: StubDbParameterCollection.SetParameter(string, DbParameter?) throws NotSupportedException. If Dapper attempts to resolve named parameters via this path in a future SDK update, the tests will throw. Currently safe because EnsureLoadedAsync only reads (SELECT) and Dapper uses positional parameters for this query type.

StubDbDataReader.GetOrdinal uses OrdinalIgnoreCase which is correct, but the ordinal lookup is inverted for Count column (returns 1 for anything not 'TagId'). If Dapper ever requests an unknown column name, it would silently return ordinal 1. Low risk in current usage.

WouldCreateParentCycle test correctly validates cycle detection. The test comment documentation is accurate: closure of proposed parent (Tag 2) already contains tagId (Tag 1) via parent edge, confirming cycle.

summary: Full review of TagsManagerTests.cs (13 cases), FilterExpressionEvaluatorM7Tests.cs (11 cases), and NameParserDetectTagsTests.cs (3 cases). Test quality is high throughout. Fakes are minimal and correctly scoped. M7 DSL test coverage confirmed complete after verifying TagsWeight/AmountTags are covered in pre-existing FilterExpressionEvaluatorTests.cs. No Fix-Forward or Documentation-Forward items. PASS.

comments.note: FilterExpressionEvaluatorM7Tests correctly scopes to M7 additions only. Pre-existing coverage concern addressed: TagsWeight (EffectiveTagWeight) and AmountTags (EffectiveTagCount) DSL identifiers are covered in the existing FilterExpressionEvaluatorTests.cs — no regression gap.

StubDbParameterCollection.SetParameter(string, DbParameter?) throws NotSupportedException. Safe for current Dapper SELECT-only usage, but if Dapper adds named-parameter resolution via this code path in a future SDK update the tests will throw unexpectedly. The Developer comment is accurate.

StubTagsRepository throws NotImplementedException on all mutation methods. This is the correct pattern for read-only test fakes: failing loudly if a mutation is accidentally invoked is safer than silently no-oping.
No observations beyond the above — test code is clean, organized, and well-documented.
